welcome.subject: Thanks for trying Pluck
welcome.intro: I'm Niall, and I make Pluck. Thanks for signing up. I wanted to say hello myself.
welcome.plucked: I can see you've plucked your first things already, so you know the main part: one tap from wherever you are, and Pluck keeps the page for you.
welcome.fresh: The quickest way in is to pluck one thing you meant to read this week: paste its link at the top of your Inbox, and Pluck keeps the page for you.
welcome.connect: One thing most people find late: your AI can read everything you pluck. Connect Pluck to Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor in about thirty seconds, then ask it what you plucked this week: {url}
welcome.expiry: And if you go quiet for a while, nothing is lost. Items you have not touched in {days, plural, =1 {# day} other {# days}} move to the Archive, and nothing is deleted.
welcome.ask: Can I ask you one thing? Reply and tell me what made you try Pluck, or what you hoped it would do. It comes straight to me, and I read every reply.
